purpose: AI-powered URL threat intelligence and phishing detection platform.

architecture.storage: JSON-based history, Local filesystem cache for screenshots

key_features: Dual-layer detection: ML classifier + Heuristic content analysis
Real-time URL, DOM, and Lexical feature extraction
Headless browser simulation with automated screenshots
Detailed risk assessment reports with plain-language explanations
PDF report export for security analysis
completed_milestones: Development of the canonical scan pipeline in scan_engine.py
ML model inference integration with feature schema validation
Refactoring of templates into modular base/index/report structure
Migration to Bootstrap 5 for professional responsiveness
Implementation of background job polling for asynchronous scanning
Addition of WHOIS intelligence and DNS resolution checks
Setup of a background task for automatic screenshot cleanup
Favicon and character set optimization for clean browser console

scan_flow.1_input: User submits URL via the hero scanner on the landing page.
scan_flow.2_pre_check: Lightweight DNS and HTTP HEAD check to identify immediate unreachability.
scan_flow.3_asynchronous_start: A unique Job ID (UUID) is generated, and a background thread initiates the scan engine.
scan_flow.4_lexical_analysis: The URL string is decomposed into 30+ features (length, special chars, tokens, etc.).
scan_flow.5_domain_intel: WHOIS records and DNS data are fetched to determine domain age and legitimacy.
scan_flow.6_browser_simulation: Headless Chrome/Firefox loads the page to extract DOM features and a screenshot.
scan_flow.7_ml_inference: A feature vector is built and passed to the Random Forest classifier for a phishing probability score.
scan_flow.8_content_analysis: Layer 2 engine scans page text for threat categories (scams, gambling, malware lures).
scan_flow.9_verdict_generation: The system synthesizes a human-friendly verdict, risk level, and evidence list.
scan_flow.10_final_delivery: The UI displays the full report and allows for PDF export.
